response.overview: After undergoing a complete cybernetic transition, a young woman wakes up to find her senses deeply fractured. Unable to trust her own eyes or the erratic, shifting landscape of her artificial vision, she drifts through a world where reality has dissolved into cold abstractions. In this void of sensory chaos, her entire grip on existence shrinks down to a single, tangible anchor: the raw physical sensation of holding a glass of water.
